purpose: Teach: 今年度/小規模/品目/原価/正社員/商社/同年/定例

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、今年度、本気で、絶対、研究計画、絶対、まとめろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — this year, I need you to pull together your research plan. I mean it.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Firm emphasis on 「本気で」 — the words of someone who trusts you but won't accept excuses. Steady eye contact. A promise and a demand in the same breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当チーム、本気で、絶対、小規模、絶対、実験、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team is genuinely committed to advancing these small-scale experiments. Thank you for your confidence in us.
lines.style: Respectful and sincere without stiffness. Slight lift at the start — acknowledgment and acceptance. Measured pace, careful emphasis on the commitments being made. Not defensive, just clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、本気で、絶対、品目、絶対、整理しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And organize your research topics. Get that sorted out.
lines.style: Clipped, practical. A follow-up instruction, not a new lecture. Tone drops slightly — no wasted words. The implication: you know what to do, so do it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費、本気で、絶対、原価、絶対、把握、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're keeping close track of research costs and making sure we understand every expense. Thank you for entrusting us with this.
lines.style: Formal and precise without sounding robotic. Slight emphasis on demonstrating competence. A beat of respect in the middle — he's showing Hiroshi they've listened and acted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、卒業後、本気で、絶対、正社員、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — after graduation, I want you aiming for a permanent position at a major company. Understood?
lines.style: Tone shifts to something more personal. Still authoritative but warmer underneath — this is investment, not just direction. Pause before the final word, giving weight to the expectation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。大手、本気で、絶対、商社、絶対、就活、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively looking at opportunities with major trading companies for our job search. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Slightly less formal here — the topic is personal now. Still respectful but with a thread of genuine engagement. A hint of determination underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、田中先輩と、本気で、絶対、同年、絶対、入学、絶対、佐藤さん、絶対、紹介しよう、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: By the way, Ren — I'll introduce you to Sato. He entered the same year as Tanaka. Take the opportunity.
lines.style: A shift to conversational warmth. The 「絶対」 repetitions here are softer — this is a gift, not a demand. Slight lean-in quality. The voice of a mentor doing what mentors do.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、本気で、絶対、定例、絶対、ゼミ、絶対、参加しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm regularly attending the lab seminars. Thank you for everything you're doing for us.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet finality. Respectful nod quality in the delivery. Slightly softer ending — gratitude that means something, not just ritual. A sense of closure to the exchange.
